catholic-encyclopedia-1913-cadiz:
Cadiz is a diocese under Seville covering nearly all of the Spanish province of Cadiz, with its bishop living in the city of Cadiz on the Isle of Leon. The old town largely burned in 1569, and the city, retaken from the Moors in 1262, was raised to a see in 1263 by Urban IV, acting at Alfonso X's request. Its first bishop was Friar Juan Martinez.

After Algeciras fell to the Christians, the bishops of Cadiz also bore the title of Algeciras, granted by Clement VI in 1352. Among its prelates was Cardinal Juan de Torquemada in 1441, a Dominican theologian who took a leading part at Basle and Florence. By the Concordat of 1851 the suppressed diocese of Ceuta joined Cadiz, which counts 32 parishes and 110 priests, with 22 parishes in Ceuta.

govdocs-archive_org-nsia-CIAOrganization:
Three organizational charts map the Central Intelligence Agency at three moments: 1950, 1961, and 1963. Each chart lays out the agency's directorates, offices, and chains of command as they stood in that year, in the CIA's own diagramming.

Read in sequence, the charts show a young agency hardening into a bureaucracy. New offices appear, the clandestine service takes shape, and the structure of 1963 stands on the eve of the Kennedy assassination. Org charts are dry documents, but for intelligence historians they are skeleton keys, fixing who reported to whom when it mattered. The three charts are filed as released, a reference set.
representative-plays-by-american-dramati:
In Mizzoura, a play in four acts by Augustus Thomas, appears in this set of representative American plays with an essay on its making. Thomas was born at St. Louis, Missouri, on January 8, 1859. The essay begins with the value of dramatists' own prefaces, citing Schiller and Victor Hugo as models.

American playwrights, it laments, seldom left such accounts of their work, and their letters went unkept. Samuel French's edition of Thomas's works repairs that loss: the playwright wrote reminiscent accounts of six plays. His own account of how In Mizzoura grew is used here, sparing the editor long comment of his own.
